name: Platypus MasterPlatypusV4 emergencyWithdraw solvency check
summary: MasterPlatypusV4.emergencyWithdraw() asked PlatypusTreasure for solvency before removing the staked LP collateral, so the check passed while the collateral was still counted. The attacker staked flash-loaned LP-USDC, borrowed the maximum USP against it, emergency-withdrew the collateral and swapped the unbacked USP for the pool's stablecoins.
notes: The faulty emergencyWithdraw ordering dates from the Nov 2022 upgrade, but it only became exploitable once MasterPlatypus was wired to PlatypusTreasure and LP-USDC was listed as USP collateral; that listing (setLpCollateralToken, a HIGH collateral config) is the latest change the exploit needed.

Campaign: every MasterPlatypus EmergencyWithdraw event in the same transaction as a PlatypusTreasure Borrow up to block 26800000; all three are by the same exploiter EOA. The only other EmergencyWithdraw (0x7986d445) followed a full repay.

Loss is the stablecoins drained from the six Platypus main-pool asset contracts; DefiLlama has no history for Avalanche BUSD, which is valued at the BUSD market price. Funds Platypus later recovered are not subtracted.
